snippet.title: Dino 'Splode (6/21/2010)
snippet.description:
Official description: Dino 'Splode is an exciting action platformer where the player controls a nearly nuclear dinosaur named Sandwich. The player travels through various unique locations, solves puzzles, survives harsh environments, and makes their way through the bloodthirsty and constantly feuding Caveman nations.

RELEASE DATE: 6/21/2010
DEVELOPER: Owen Deery
GENRE: Platformer
Offline players 1
